mappings.requirement_text: Incident handling requires security infrastructure that generates reliable audit logs.
Incident handling and detection require retained log delivery for detection.
Cryptography and encryption policies must be applied to data at rest.
Cryptography requires documented key management and rotation.
Access control policies and asset management: least-privilege IAM.
Risk management: network and information system security.
Policies and procedures to assess effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.
